quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #9
										  					
  

20 Questions • Passing Score 14

questions.question: When the road has a solid yellow line and a broken yellow line, with the broken line on your side, when may you pass?

options.text: Only in an emergency.
Only on an expressway.
When traffic is clear.
Only at an intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: When traffic is clear.
questions.explanation: When you see a solid yellow line and a broken yellow line with the broken line on your side, you may cross to pass if no traffic is coming toward you.

questions.question: What color are warning signs that show upcoming hazards?

options.text: Black letters or symbols on white background
Black letters or symbols on yellow background
White letters or symbols on blue background
White letters or symbols on green background

questions.correctAnswerText: Black letters or symbols on yellow background
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black letters or symbols. Work zone signs are orange with black letters or symbols.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: You must stop for other traffic.
Traffic is entering from another road. Give them space to merge safely.
Traffic is entering from another road. Stay in the right lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic is entering from another road. Give them space to merge safely.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that traffic will merge into your lane. Check your mirrors and side windows, then move to another lane if possible to let them merge safely.

questions.question: Before you pull out of a parallel parking space, you should:

options.text: Sound your horn.
Turn on your four-way flashers.
Turn your head to look for traffic.
Use only your rearview mirror to check for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn your head to look for traffic.
questions.explanation: Before pulling out, turn your head and look over your shoulder through the window. Check for pedestrians, bicyclists, motorcycles, and other vehicles.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Drive slowly and sound your horn.
A bus stop is ahead.
You are entering a school parking lot.
A school zone is ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A school zone is ahead.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you that a school zone is coming. Slow down and watch for children.

questions.question: What does a double solid yellow line in the center of the road mean?

options.text: Passing is allowed from both directions.
Passing is allowed from your direction only.
Passing is not allowed from either direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: Passing is not allowed from either direction.
questions.explanation: A double yellow line means no traffic from either direction may cross to pass.

questions.question: Drivers under the influence of alcohol are:

options.text: Not a problem in New York State.
A danger to every driver.
Only a police problem.
Only a problem for people who drink.

questions.correctAnswerText: A danger to every driver.
questions.explanation: An impaired or drunk driver is dangerous to themselves and to everyone on the road.

questions.question: When another vehicle is tailgating you, what should you do?

options.text: Move to the right lane if one is open.
If no right lane is available, wait until the road ahead is clear, then slow down gradually to let them pass.
Never brake suddenly.
Do all of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: Do all of the above.
questions.explanation: If tailgated, move right if possible. If not, wait until ahead is clear and slow down gradually to encourage them to pass. Never brake suddenly, as this increases the risk of being hit from behind.

questions.question: If an oncoming vehicle is heading toward you in your lane, what should you do?

options.text: Honk, steer right, and speed up.
Honk, steer left, and brake.
Honk, steer right, and brake.
Stay in your lane, honk, and brake.

questions.correctAnswerText: Honk, steer right, and brake.
questions.explanation: Honk to alert them. If they don't move, steer right to escape. Steering left risks a crash if they correct at the last moment. Brake firmly and steadily. Each mile per hour you slow down reduces impact force.

questions.question: You hit a parked car and cannot find the owner. What must you do?

options.text: Call your insurance company when you get home.
Wait for the owner to return.
Leave a note with your name and address on the car.

questions.correctAnswerText: Leave a note with your name and address on the car.
questions.explanation: You must leave a note with your name, phone number, and address attached to the vehicle you hit.

questions.question: To pass a slower vehicle on a two-lane road, you must:

options.text: Not cross the centerline.
Flash your lights at oncoming traffic.
Use the shoulder.
Use the lane for oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Use the lane for oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: To pass on a two-lane road, you must use the lane for oncoming traffic. Only pass if it is safe and legal.

questions.question: A flashing red light means:

options.text: The same thing as a stop sign.
The traffic signal is broken.
You do not have to stop completely.
Road conditions are dangerous.

questions.correctAnswerText: The same thing as a stop sign.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light means the same thing as a stop sign. Come to a complete stop, yield to other traffic and pedestrians, and proceed only when it is safe.

questions.question: When you see a flashing red traffic light, you should:

options.text: Drive through if there is no crossing traffic.
Continue driving because you have the right-of-way.
Stop only if a police officer is nearby.
Treat it like a stop sign.

questions.correctAnswerText: Treat it like a stop sign.
questions.explanation: Flashing red lights are used at dangerous intersections. Treat them like stop signs.

questions.question: What happens if you refuse a chemical test?

options.text: There is no proof of drunk driving.
You cannot be arrested for drunk driving.
Your license will be taken away.
None of these choices.

questions.correctAnswerText: Your license will be taken away.
questions.explanation: By driving, you agree to take a chemical test if arrested for drinking or drugs. If you refuse, your license will be suspended. If the DMV confirms you refused, your license will be revoked, even if you are found not guilty.

questions.question: You see an emergency vehicle with flashing lights behind you on a city street. What should you do?

options.text: Drive to the right edge and slow down.
Drive to the right edge and stop.
Stay in your lane, slow down, and let it pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive to the right edge and stop.
questions.explanation: You must yield to any emergency vehicle using its siren and lights. Drive to the right edge and stop until it passes. If you are in an intersection, drive through first, then stop.

questions.question: You have the right-of-way when you are:

options.text: Entering a traffic circle.
Backing out of a driveway.
Leaving a parking space.
Already inside a traffic circle.

questions.correctAnswerText: Already inside a traffic circle.
questions.explanation: Drivers already inside a traffic circle have the right-of-way. Drivers entering must yield. Drivers leaving a driveway or parking space must yield to traffic and pedestrians already on the road.

questions.question: Bicyclists differ from motorists in that they are not required to:

options.text: Obey traffic laws.
Signal all turns.
Report serious injury accidents.
Insure the bicycle.

questions.correctAnswerText: Insure the bicycle.
questions.explanation: Bicyclists must obey the same traffic laws as drivers and signal all turns. Any bicycle crash causing serious injury must be reported to the DMV within 10 days.

questions.question: The best way to avoid hydroplaning is to:

options.text: Keep your tires properly maintained.
Slow down when roads are wet or slushy.
Watch for standing water or puddles.
All of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: All of the above.
questions.explanation: Wet roads increase stopping distance and cause skidding. Do not use cruise control in wet or icy conditions. Reduce speed and drive with caution.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Stop sign ahead.
Side road.
Railroad warning.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop sign ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a stop sign is coming up ahead.

questions.question: Minimum speed signs are used to:

options.text: Keep traffic flowing smoothly.
Show current local road conditions.
Test future traffic signal needs.
Ensure pedestrian safety.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep traffic flowing smoothly.
questions.explanation: Some highways have minimum speed limits to keep traffic flowing. Driving too slowly can create dangerous conditions and result in a ticket.
